candidate_risk.reason: Surveyed station and body route may not realize in Native map

trigger.source: Native subject spawn and first original body pose
trigger.metric: subject spawn succeeds and body clears road surface
trigger.failure_condition: Primary 0.3 m spawn offset collides with surveyed entrance geometry; 0.45 m clears the same station route.

trigger.source: original subject path and selected route waypoint history
trigger.metric: nearest distance to each mapped route waypoint in metres
trigger.failure_condition: Primary 2.0 m radius misses the next waypoint under map tessellation; 3.0 m permits progression on the same route.

trigger.metric: peak-to-peak speed tracking error in m/s
trigger.failure_condition: Primary steering/speed control oscillates around requested speed; reduced gain stabilizes the same reversal path.

delivery_acceptance.scope: CPU diagnostic proofs; native source/pixel/physical checks execute after actual capture
